core_mechanic: Content arrives on a calendar; the game itself is a platform for evolving rotations.
player_motivation: Be present for the moment; ride the season.

essential_feel.season_rhythm: every season has a clear theme, story arc, and reward track
essential_feel.event_density: limited-time events 1-3 per season, each ~1 week
essential_feel.fomo_management: missed cosmetics return on rotation; missed gameplay feels survivable

pacing_profile.early: Onboarding to the current season; catch-up XP for late joiners.
pacing_profile.mid: Mid-season event expands the meta with new mode or map.
pacing_profile.late: Finale event resolves the season's story arc; rewards finalize.

progression_model.completion_definition: Per-season completion (battle-pass tier 100, season story finale); the live game itself is never 'finished'.
progression_model.content_cadence: Per season (6-12 weeks) plus mid-season event drops; daily/weekly challenges refresh the loop.

canonical_examples.title: Fortnite (chapter system)
canonical_examples.what_makes_it_special: Map-altering live events anchor each chapter in a shared moment.

anti_patterns: Battle pass length that requires more than the season's hours to finish
Seasons that recycle the previous season's mechanics with no net-new verb
